card.name: Words before paired body parts
card.fires_on: The word "each" (or a small linking word) right before a paired or located body part such as cheek, buttock, scapula or corrugator muscle. It appears in injection-site and application-site lists and in anatomical descriptions.

modes.label: "each" before a body site
modes.description: "each" introduces one of a pair of sites for an injection or topical application.

modes.label: Anatomy description wording
modes.description: A small word or word start sits just before a body region in a descriptive anatomical passage.
modes.example: The young have a white line extending from<< the>> corner of the mouth down the neck.

card.writes: It promotes body-part words such as hip, thigh and shoulder, so a paired body region is likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a body part is named, especially "each" in lists of injection or application sites.
